proof_status: New weak-gluing proofs written and internally checked. Not independently peer reviewed or formally verified; no exhaustive novelty claim.
new_results_within_specified_setup: All q, smooth rational weak del Pezzo S and smooth anticanonical E: R_q is left and right noetherian; graded Ext modules of every object are finitely generated and cohomologically bounded.
Construction of the natural coherent dg functor Phi_q:D_q to Db(qgr R_q), with kernel equal to the complete anticanonical orbit-null category and iota_q ker Rf_*.
The dg quotient is a gluing of O_(Sbar)^perp in Db(coh Sbar) and an exceptional object, with boundary module RHom_E(Li^*(-),q).
For non-genuine S, the quotient has an object with nonzero self-Ext in infinitely many degrees and is not proper; this is not transferred to the unproved qgr identification.

primary_inputs_checked.Keeler: math/9912051v2 Theorem 1.2(1),(2); covers both finite- and infinite-order translations.
primary_inputs_checked.BKS: 1801.08286v1 Theorem 2.14 and section 2F; projective map, geometric fibres of dimension at most one, Rf_*O=O.

not_proved: For general nontrivial q, the induced singular-gluing functor to Db(qgr R_q) is fully faithful and essentially surjective.
Wall AS comparison, placement of contraction objects in specified hearts, local completed algebra, and relative descent.
